experiment: B1: Zero-JS-Runtime Fast Stage 0 Bootstrap (Pure Source -> Native C stage0_seed)

environment.toolchain: gcc 10.2.1 (no clang installed on host) + bun 1.4.3 (selfhost/.assets/bin/bun)

monolithic_bend2_baseline.c_units_outcome: FAILED / OOM-risk: >270s wall and >20 GiB RSS due to multi-pass fixed-point loop + WIDE=247 ADT flattening + m05 arity>247 crash

modular_c_stage0_measured.stage4_gcc_remaining_6_blocker: arr_q Array fact changed mid-pass in 1-pass c_units (fixed in gen_comp_mod.py by pinning fact('type','Array')=false)

key_root_causes_discovered: No clang on host (only gcc 10.2.1), which lacks __attribute__((musttail)); solved via O(1)-stack WLState* trampoline ABI.
Monolithic bend2 --to-c on compiler.bend blows up to >270s and >20 GiB RSS due to multi-pass c_units() fixed-point loop and WIDE=247 ADT flattening.

GCC -O1 with bend2's 48-arg stack ABI took 39.93s/MB and failed sibling-tail-call on 237/351 WL_JMPs (Term fb[N] stack-escape); WLState* trampoline + -O1 -fno-inline + const seq=1u cut GCC compile time 4x and eliminated stack overflow.

Modular K=16 C emission hit 3 subtle bugs all diagnosed & fixed: (1) non-@unsafe stubs unfolded infinitely, (2) once=true inlined mutually-recursive module pairs, (3) non-flat stubs for 1-line x188_* helpers exploded m05/m06 into 1133-1587 CPS continuations (m05 arity>247 crash, fixed via leaf helper inlining).
Final 6-module gcc error (spin_agy_str_eq arity mismatch) traced to fact('type','Array') flipping mid-pass in 1-pass c_units(); fixed in gen_comp_mod.py.

path_to_sub_45s.remaining_bottleneck: m06 (41.2s bun, 21.8 MB C, 5.7 MB .o) due to 3 x86 machine-code builders (w13e_sa_rew_body, w14a_sl_copy_3, w13e_sa_chk_body) calling >4-line helpers that remain stubbed.
path_to_sub_45s.projected_after_m06_fix_and_4core_bun: 1.7s stubs + ~18s bun (4-core) + 2.0s merge + ~18s gcc -O1 -fno-inline (8-core) + 1.0s link = ~41s wall (<= 45s).
